name: kanban
description:
One person. A whole team behind you. AI4Kanban organizes your agents, follows through on the work, and checks the results; you set the direction and make the big calls. AI4Kanban is local-first.

Example 1: say "what's next?" — Claude ranks the cards you already have and names the top three to build; "what are we missing?" proposes new ones.
Example 2: say "add a task: …" — Claude reviews the idea, writes a clear card, and adds it to the index.
Example 3: say "dive deeper on #4" — Claude pushes card #4 one stage toward a concrete plan.
Example 4: say "#4 is done" — Claude compresses it into the archive and removes the card.
